map.name: Signal Garden: O/X
map.description: A fast true-or-false survival quiz on two opposing platforms.

text.objectives: Judge each statement before the timer expires; keep at least one life through the final question.
briefing: Questions appear in sequence with a short answer timer.
Stand on the left O platform for true or the right X platform for false.
A wrong answer or no answer costs one life. Survive every question to win.

messages.start: Signal Garden has {questions} statements and {lives} lives.
messages.directions: Move to O for true or X for false before {seconds} seconds run out.
messages.no_answer: Statement {number}: no platform chosen. The answer was {answer}.
messages.out_of_lives: No lives remain. The signal ends here.
messages.survived: Every statement judged. You kept your signal alive.
messages.question: Question {number}: {prompt}

questions.prompt: A Vespene geyser emits gas that workers can harvest.
A Dragoon is a Terran infantry unit.
A player can control units from more than one race in a Use Map.
A Zergling attacks air units by default.
A Protoss Photon Cannon can attack both ground and air units.
